title: Ball Wall Games
tagline: Throw the ball. Trigger the action.
shortDescription: Real balls, a digital wall: every throw or kick lands on a live projection that reacts at the exact point of impact, turning sport and play into a show for everyone around.
longDescription: A physical game where players throw, kick, or hit real balls against a large projected wall, and every impact triggers an instant reaction at the exact spot it lands. The same setup runs penalty shoot-outs against a virtual goalkeeper, target and puzzle games, team missions, and arcade challenges with points and timers. It works indoors and outdoors, from a school gym to a city square, and draws crowds because everyone can see the action. Games, visuals, and difficulty are configurable for children, teams, or competitive adults. BRDGE handles the interaction logic, scene management, and journey, leaderboard, and data links end to end.

highlights.title: Real Sport, Digital Magic
highlights.description: A real ball in the hand makes it instantly understood: throw, kick, or smash, and the wall answers. It feels like sport, not like screen time.

highlights.title: One Wall, Many Games
highlights.description: Switch between a penalty shoot-out, target practice, puzzle walls, and team missions on the same setup, so one booking covers a whole day of different audiences.

highlights.title: Indoors or Out
highlights.description: It works in a gym, a hall, a fan zone, or a town square, and the size of the wall can grow with the venue.

highlights.title: Change the Rules
highlights.description: Add timed rounds, team-versus-team missions, a tournament bracket, rackets or bats instead of hands, or a final boss round that the whole crowd tries to beat together.

highlights.title: Kick Into Any World
highlights.description: Play a goalkeeper duel for a football sponsor, a temple adventure for kids, a space mission for a tech brand, or a festive target game for a winter market.

highlights.title: Scores Worth Sharing
highlights.description: Add a data layer that records players, scores, hits, and rounds per day, and turn it into a live leaderboard or a prize threshold that keeps people coming back.

highlights.title: Part of the Game Zone
highlights.description: Pair with Reaction Games and MultiPlay Game Station for a full arcade, with Live Feed to put the leaderboard on the big screen, or with Prize Draw to reward the best scores.
